summary: Native static ARM64 fbdev+evdev GUI started in RAM on actual N71 Linux: 750x1334 32bpp fb0 and touchscreen event0. Initial four near-edge hit target framebuffer center pixels were amber; after real evdev input all four center pixels read cyan. USB Linux remained connected. Functional input-to-framebuffer update PASS; optical panel scanout and calibrated physical coordinates are not yet independently confirmed.
